title: Lesson Streak Recovery
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=yousician:lesson) OR (index=personal sourcetype=simplypiano:session)
| stats max(_time) as last_lesson by platform instrument_name
| eval days_since_lesson=round((now()-last_lesson)/86400,1)
| where days_since_lesson>3
| sort - days_since_lesson
description: Detects when lesson-app practice streaks have gone cold for more than a few days.
value: Musical momentum fades quickly, so a low-friction streak recovery nudge can preserve habit and finger memory.
implementation: Normalize practice sessions from Yousician and Simply Piano into a shared cadence report by instrument.
visualization: Table of platform and instrument by days since last lesson.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when your music-learning streak has cooled off and needs a nudge.
